faq.title: NIS2 & CyFun: your questions, our answers
faq.lead: Your most frequent questions. Another one in mind? Ask it during the free diagnostic.

q1.question: Am I concerned by NIS2?
q1.a1: Depending on your sector and your size. NIS2 targets essential entities (energy, healthcare, transport, finance…) and important ones (manufacturing, food industry, digital services…). Many SMEs are concerned indirectly, as suppliers or subcontractors.
q1.a2: In doubt? Our free diagnostic clarifies your situation in a single conversation.

q2.question: What is the difference between CyFun and ISO/IEC 27001?
q2.a1: ISO/IEC 27001 is the international reference standard for information security. CyFun is the CCB's Belgian framework, designed to meet NIS2 and aligned with ISO 27001 and the NIST CSF.
q2.a2: In practice: CyFun is a more accessible entry point for an SME, with its three progressive levels (Basic → Essential), and a first step towards ISO 27001 if needed.

q3.question: Does Smidjan deliver the CyFun certification?
q3.a1: No. Smidjan is not a certification body, nor BELAC-accredited. The official CyFun certification is issued by BELAC-accredited bodies (Brand Compliance, Trust CHECK, Normec CertUp), independent of us.
q3.a2: Our role: audit, remediate, prepare your file up to submission. We get you ready: the accredited body validates your level.

q4.question: How long does it take to become compliant?
q4.a1: It depends on the targeted level and your starting maturity. As an indication: 1 to 3 months for Basic, 3 to 6 months for Important, 6 to 12 months for Essential.
q4.a2: NIS2 is already in force: better to start now. The earlier you begin, the more you spread out the effort and the budget, and reduce your exposure.

q5.question: What happens if I do nothing?
q5.a1: Significant fines, management liability engaged. And above all: an incident (ransomware, data breach) costs far more than early compliance.
q5.a2: The CyFun approach reduces a real risk, not just a box to tick.

q6.question: Which CyFun level should I choose for my SME?
q6.a1: For most SMEs, Important is the best balance, the most common. Basic already covers the essentials. Essential targets « essential » NIS2 entities and strong security requirements.
q6.a2: The right level depends on your NIS2 category and your exposure. We recommend it to you from the scoping stage.

cyfun.title: NIS2 & CyFun: <accent>are you concerned?</accent>
cyfun.lead: NIS2 is the European directive that requires a minimum level of cybersecurity from essential and important entities, SMEs and subcontractors included. In Belgium it relies on the CyFun framework (CyberFundamentals), published by the CCB.
cyfun.hook: Already covers the bulk of common attacks. The best starting point for an SME.
cyfun.deadlineText: In force since 18 October 2024. Anticipating reduces the risk.
cyfun.fine: Non-compliance: administrative fines and personal liability of management.

diagnostic.title: A clear gap report, domain by domain
diagnostic.text: Every CyFun requirement is measured, not guessed. A maturity level per domain (governance, access, network, detection, continuity) aggregated into a global score.

faq.title: NIS2 & CyFun: your questions, answered
faq.lead: The questions we get most often. Another one in mind? Ask it during the free assessment.

q1.question: Does NIS2 apply to me?
q1.a1: NIS2 targets essential and important entities; many SMEs are covered indirectly, as subcontractors or suppliers.
q1.a2: Not sure? The free assessment settles your case in one conversation.

q2.question: CyFun or ISO 27001: which one?
q2.a1: CyFun (CCB) is the Belgian framework built for NIS2, aligned with ISO 27001: more accessible to start, with three progressive levels.
q2.a2: It stays a first step toward ISO 27001 if you aim further.

q3.question: How long does compliance take?
q3.a1: As a guide: 1 to 3 months for Basic, 3 to 6 for Important, 6 to 12 for Essential, depending on your starting maturity.
q3.a2: NIS2 is already in force: starting early spreads the effort and budget.

q4.question: What if I do nothing?
q4.a1: Administrative fines and management liability, and above all an incident risk far costlier than getting compliant early.
q4.a2: The process reduces a real risk, not just a checkbox.

q5.question: Does Smidjan issue the CyFun certificate?
q5.a1: No. CyFun certification is granted by BELAC-accredited bodies, independent from us.
q5.a2: Our role: audit, remediate and get you ready for the verification.
